keyPoints.en: Exothermic: heat released, surroundings get hotter (combustion, respiration, neutralisation, rusting, dissolving NaOH).
keyPoints.bm: Eksotermik: haba dibebaskan, persekitaran menjadi panas (pembakaran, respirasi, peneutralan, pengaratan, melarutkan NaOH).

keyPoints.en: Endothermic: heat absorbed, surroundings get colder (photosynthesis, dissolving NH₄Cl or NH₄NO₃, heating CaCO₃).
keyPoints.bm: Endotermik: haba diserap, persekitaran menjadi sejuk (fotosintesis, melarutkan NH₄Cl atau NH₄NO₃, memanaskan CaCO₃).

keyPoints.en: Measure the initial and final temperatures; use an insulated (polystyrene) cup.
keyPoints.bm: Ukur suhu awal dan akhir; guna cawan bertebat (polistirena).

keyPoints.en: Uses: fuels, hot packs, self-heating cans (exo); cold packs (endo).
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan: bahan api, pek panas, tin memanaskan sendiri (ekso); pek sejuk (endo).

tip.en: Exo = exit (heat goes out); Endo = enter (heat comes in).
tip.bm: Ekso = keluar (haba keluar); Endo = masuk (haba masuk).
